start: Import members screen, signed in as owner, an .xlsx from another software with name, mobile, plan name, start, end, total, paid, balance

steps.action: Open 'Import members' and pick the file
user_sees: The sheet most like a member list is picked by itself (most different mobile numbers); empty or one-line sheets are not offered
must_not: A payments sheet (one row per payment) picked as the member list

steps.action: Check the matched columns and run the import
user_sees: Each row with an end date becomes a real membership: plan named as in the sheet (or 'Imported plan'), price = paid + balance when that is less than the total, paid = what the sheet says
must_not: A due larger than the sheet's balance; a row with no end date and no plan length made into a membership

steps.action: Open one imported member
user_sees: Plan, start, end and paid amount as in the sheet; no joining fee is asked at the first renewal
must_not: A false joining-fee due on an imported member; a date one day early

start: Import members screen as owner; another KIND of file: CSV, old .xls, or a web page saved as .xls with dates like 01/08/2026

steps.action: Pick the file
user_sees: It is read like an Excel file; 01/08/2026 is read day-first (1 Aug); bold or colour tags inside a cell are dropped ('Riya Sharma', not 'RiyaSharma')
must_not: 1 Aug read as 8 Jan; names glued together; a date a day early

steps.action: Run the import
user_sees: The same memberships as from an .xlsx of the same rows
must_not: A different number of members or a different due than the .xlsx gives

start: Import members screen as owner; a workbook with several sheets (members, payments, an empty sheet)

steps.action: Pick the file
user_sees: Only sheets with a header row and at least one more row are offered; the member list is picked first; the others can be chosen
must_not: The empty sheet offered; the payments sheet chosen by itself

steps.action: Choose the payments sheet as well and import
user_sees: Payments repeat a member; with price and balance known, paid so far is price minus balance
must_not: The same payment counted twice; paid more than the plan price shown as a minus due

start: Import members screen as owner; wrong files: a PDF or a picture, a sheet with only a header row, a row whose start is after its end

steps.action: Pick a file that is not a spreadsheet
user_sees: A plain message that this file is not a spreadsheet (exact words unknown: screen not read)
must_not: A blank screen, an endless spinner, or a raw error

steps.action: Pick a sheet with rows that have no end date and no readable plan length, or start after end
user_sees: Those rows import as members only, with no membership
must_not: A membership with a made-up end date; a membership that ends before it starts

start: Import members screen as owner, one past import in the list; since the import the gym edited one imported member, took a receipt against another, and checked a third in

steps.action: Tap 'Undo this import' on that import
user_sees: The count of records it would still remove; the three used members and their plans and receipts are kept
must_not: A member the gym edited, charged or checked in deleted; a voided imported receipt deleted

steps.action: Confirm
user_sees: Receipts go first, then memberships, members, plans; a plan still used by a kept membership stays
must_not: A kept membership left pointing at a deleted plan or member

steps.action: Open Import members again
user_sees: The import leaves the list once nothing is left to undo; with only kept records it is not listed
must_not: 'Undo this import' still shown with 0 records; a second undo removing kept records

start: Import members screen as owner; a sheet with Aadhaar / PAN columns and other personal columns

steps.action: Pick the file and look at the matched columns
user_sees: ID-number columns are not matched to any member field
must_not: An Aadhaar or PAN number saved on a member, in notes or anywhere else

steps.action: Import, then undo the import
user_sees: Only rows of this gym carrying this import's id are removed
must_not: A record of another import, or one the gym added by hand, removed
